summary.text: Steve Elkins is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 50B and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists no opponent on the ballot. A former Bloomington City Council and Metropolitan Council member, he worked as an information technology architect.

paragraphs.text: Steve Elkins was born in Oakland, California, and lives in Bloomington, Minnesota.
He graduated from Bishop O'Dowd High School in 1970 and earned a B.A. in economics from the University of California, Berkeley, in 1975.

Ballotpedia says he worked in information technology as a data architect at Wells Fargo, information architect at Boundary Medical, information solutions architect at Daugherty Business Solutions, and senior enterprise data architect at OptumTechnology.
Elkins served on the Bloomington City Council and the Metropolitan Council of the Twin Cities, and was defeated by Geoff Michel in a 2010 race for Minnesota Senate District 41.
He won the House seat in District 49B on November 6, 2018, defeating Matt Sikich, and defeated Bob Gust in District 50B on November 5, 2024.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he listed protecting reproductive rights, reducing gun violence and defending free and fair elections as his key campaign messages.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committees as Commerce Finance and Policy (co-vice chair), Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy, Health Finance and Policy, and House Taxes.
